newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria guarantees grain credits with 260 bln lvs.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria guarantees grain credits with 260 bln lvs.

text.p: The State Fund for Reconstruction and Development (SFRD) will place guarantees worth 260 billion levs with Bulgaria's commercial banks to cover credits to state companies for wheat purchases, the finance minister said.
Minister Muravei Radev told reporters the decision was adopted at Thursday's cabinet meeting.
"The SFRD will place a state guarantee covering only loans extended by commercial banks to state-owned firms which are buying wheat from this year's crop from producers," he said.
The state guarantee will not cover loans extended by the commercial banks to private or municipal companies, Radev said.
So far the State Savings Bank, Bulbank, United Bulgarian Bank, Expressbank, Hebrosbank and Central Co-operative Bank have offered their services to the SFRD.
Funds available in the SFRD total 571.2 billion levs, the balance sheet of Bulgarian National Bank's Issue Department showed.
Agriculture Minister Ventsislav Varbanov declined to specify the amount of funds needed to purchase the wheat from this year's crop. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 911 88
